note: Input for scripts/build-hero-outfits.py. One Sidekick preset per hero becomes a six-slot armor set; `set` prefixes the item ids and file names. Change `preset` to any of the pack's six (see .tmp-outfits/previews after --previews) and rebuild.

descriptions.head: A deep hood cut for the forest paths; it keeps the rain and the archers' glare off.
descriptions.chest: Layered leather over a linen shirt, with a quiver strapped across the back.
descriptions.shoulders: Light leaf-plate mantles that never catch a bowstring.
descriptions.hands: Supple bracers worn smooth by the draw.
descriptions.legs: Leggings stitched for long marches and quiet steps.
descriptions.boots: Soft-soled boots for moving where nobody hears you.

descriptions.head: A tall hat that has seen more storms than its wearer admits to.
descriptions.chest: A long robe worked with sigils, with a satchel of components slung behind.
descriptions.shoulders: Weighted pauldrons that keep the sleeves from the casting hand.
descriptions.hands: Gloves cut back at the fingers so nothing dulls the spell.
descriptions.boots: Sturdy boots; sorcerers still walk everywhere.
